```{=html}
<div class="banner" id="wildlife-banner">
<img src="photography/wildlife/reptiles/thumbs/Acontias_meleagris.jpg" alt="" class="active" loading="eager">
<img src="photography/wildlife/reptiles/thumbs/Agkistrodon_contortrix_PA_2023_2.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/amphibians/thumbs/Agalychnis_callidryas_Sierpe_3_CR_26.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/amphibians/thumbs/Ambystoma_maculatum_NY_2025_4.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/birds/thumbs/Bay_breasted_warbler.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/birds/thumbs/Chestnut_mandibled_toucan_1_Cloudbridge_CR_26.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/mammals/thumbs/African_elephant_KZN_2019_2.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
<img src="photography/wildlife/mammals/thumbs/Collared_Peccary_Cloudbridge_CR_26.jpg" alt="" class="" loading="lazy">
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var s = document.querySelectorAll("#wildlife-banner img"), i = 0;
  if (s.length < 2) return;
  setInterval(function () {
    s[i].classList.remove("active");
    i = (i + 1) % s.length;
    s[i].classList.add("active");
  }, 5000);
})();
</script>
```
